items.title: School Year Blessings Backpack
items.alt: A yellow backpack, blue globe, closed notebook and red apple sit beneath a green “SCHOOL YEAR BLESSINGS” ribbon.
items.description: Brown edging and two zippered pockets give the bag a clear school-day silhouette beside the globe’s complete stand.

items.title: Holiday Blessings Gift Sled
items.alt: A red wooden sled carries a green scarf, wrapped gift and pine branches beneath gold “HOLIDAY BLESSINGS” lettering.
items.description: Curled runner tips, a bright red bow and small pine cones frame the compact festive gift arrangement.

items.title: Spring Blessings Tulip Boots
items.alt: Pink and yellow tulips fill blue gardening boots below pink-and-gold “SPRING BLESSINGS” lettering.
items.description: Pale checked bows wrap the boot tops, and smaller white flowers fill the gaps between the tall tulip stems.

items.title: Summer Blessings Straw Hat
items.alt: A woven straw hat with a coral bow and pale tropical flowers sits beneath yellow-and-teal “SUMMER BLESSINGS” lettering.
items.description: The wide textured brim and oversized ribbon loops form a low, warm-weather greeting graphic.

items.title: Winter Blessings Candle Lantern
items.alt: A navy lantern with a lit candle is wrapped in an ivory scarf behind a “WINTER BLESSINGS” ribbon.
items.description: Gold-edged glass panels, small star openings and a pine cone finish the dark lantern beneath its full curved handle.

items.title: Harvest Blessings Apples and Wheat
items.alt: Red and green apples fill a metal pail beside a tied wheat sheaf under burgundy “HARVEST BLESSINGS” lettering.
items.description: A wooden grip crosses the pail’s curved handle, balancing the tall golden wheat and small autumn-leaf accents.
